scope: Hypothetical common-clock branching and calibration measurement study. No patient/cancer-cell fit or novelty claim.
previous_goal_turn: Progress: commit c7d952f3f1bdf87cd02c8f7f018ac38b9c398ce4 was published with a clean working tree and verified anonymous access. The old two flags and 168 unresolved checks remain unchanged.
model: All stage-transition/division and death hazards multiply r(b)=1+a*sin(2*pi*b/P), r>0. Operational clock R(b)=b+a*P/(2*pi)*(1-cos(2*pi*b/P)). This is a restricted time-change model, not division-only modulation or a drug schedule.

times.selected_path_queries: For each horizon T, evaluate sorted unique {0,0.5,1,1.5,2,T}: 5+6+6 queries per case, 340 total.
times.birth_bin_boundary: Left-closed/right-open, except each partition final bin includes right endpoint 2. Events exactly on boundaries have zero probability under continuous clocks; synthetic fixtures must check this convention.

pair_cohort: The first founder division before death by physical time 2 supplies a prospective pair. Both newborn daughters are observed at the same elapsed physical lag, without future selection. Daughter types are conditionally independent with K=rho I+(1-rho)/number_of_types. Calibration singles come from independent eligible mothers with the same birth-bin and type distribution; one random daughter per mother.

calibration.random_unit: One whole experiment: an independent Binomial(m,p) calibration sample is reused across n iid target pairs. Unbiasedness averages over training and target samples, not conditional on one realized training fit.
calibration.analytic: All 20 cases x 3 lags x 15 bins x 3 calibration sizes x 2 target sizes = 5,400 settings. Primary residual moments use finite binomial sums; the independent verifier uses closed moment formulas. All four methods are retained.
calibration.seed_spawn: PCG64 SeedSequence([entropy,case_index,lag_index,bin_index,m_index,n_index]); zero-based indices in protocol order. In each fixed batch draw calibration binomial values first, then four-category target multinomial counts in order 00,01,10,11.
calibration.validation: Each method mean and mean squared deviation about its analytic mean are checked with nonasymptotic Bernstein bounds. The latter has variance upper bound B^2*Var(score). All 5,760 checks share family alpha 0.001 by Bonferroni; numerical slack 1e-8. Exact-zero-variance controls are checked as structural constants. No Gaussian tail claim.
calibration.moments_scope: The calibration and pair distributions are fixed within an experiment. Shared random movie/well effects, calibration distribution shift and general fitted-regression error are not simulated. Coarse bins retain context mixing.

formula_authority.scope: Sections5,6,8 fix estimator identities, finite variances and bounds. Optional paired-estimator covariance, exact conditional null tests and separate-clock model are not new primary numerical targets.

calibration.oracle_bin_mean_formula: Mean over target pairs of (A1-p)*(A2-p), with true bin marginal p. Mean=c; variance=[v^2-c^2+c*(1-2*p)^2]/n, v=p*(1-p). It still retains within-bin context covariance.
calibration.naive_mean_variance_formula: Mean=c+v/m; variance=[A+2*v*(v+c)/m]/n+2*v^2/m^2+v*(1-6*v)/m^3, A=v^2-c^2+c*(1-2*p)^2. Independently verify against finite binomial sums before stochastic validation.

tree_simulation.seed_spawn: PCG64 SeedSequence([entropy,case_index]); zero-based case indices. Generation and within-batch draw order must be fixed in code and pinned before any run.
tree_simulation.boundary: Alive on [birth,event); division at a query replaces the mother with daughters. Synthetic exact division/death ties choose death. Every daughter is newborn stage 1. Latest physical query 4 equals operational time 4.
tree_simulation.validation: 60 family-inclusion, 300 birth-bin eligibility, 10 eligible maternal-type and 2,700 conditional pair-binary checks: 3,070 two-sided exact-binomial diagnostics at 0.001/3070. Also 340 conditional Q means, 140 unconditional U means and 240 unconditional positive removed-stratum loss means: 720 Bernstein diagnostics with variance upper bound mean*(1-mean), family alpha 0.001/720, and numerical slack 1e-8. No Gaussian paired-influence gate. Zero selected counts stay undefined; pair counts below 2 have undefined covariance.
tree_simulation.removed_stratum_loss: (1-U(t))*(F_early-F_late), averaged over all prospective founders; its reference mean is h_early*(1-Q_early)-h_late*(1-Q_late). This unconditional loss is defined and equals zero if no removed families are observed; any conditional removed-cohort mean is undefined when its denominator is zero.
tree_simulation.q_conditioning: Given the number selected at horizon T, their U(t) values are iid from the selected law and bounded in [0,1]. The concentration check conditions on that count. Its simultaneous validity does not require independent overlapping horizons.
tree_simulation.pair_covariance_reporting: Report unbiased within-bin sample covariance, but validate its underlying marginal and joint binary probabilities with the specified exact-binomial gates. No unplanned covariance significance test.

numeric.reference: Independent extinction/forward equations or closed forms and a distinct quadrature implementation. The pinned old core may be reused by production; the independent verifier cannot import the new production module. Direct physical-time backward-ODE fixtures separately check the clock transformation.

limits: The common-clock time change is restrictive; it does not cover separately modulated division and death hazards.
Corrected shared calibration has a fixed-m variance floor; ordinary sample covariance is the simpler explicit benchmark.
Coarse-bin covariance retains context mixing and does not identify inheritance.
Even exact-birth inherited covariance can be observationally equivalent to a shared latent family environment.
There is no clinical time or dose mapping, external contact, or modification of previous outputs.
numerical_roundoff: Retain raw numerical values. Any projection to a probability domain for sampling must be recorded and at most 1e-8; a larger excursion fails. Use exact structural values for zero-death controls. Checks retain numerical slack instead of claiming interval-arithmetic certainty.
initial_distribution: Equal initial probability for each of the one or two types. Newborn means stage1; uniform_stage means each stage1..k has probability1/k within type. Every daughter is stage1. Uniform stages are not a claimed stable population age distribution.
stopping_and_preservation: Do not alter parameters, seeds, sample counts or gates after outputs. Pin code and environment before runs. Preserve first outputs, partial failed cases and error diagnostics; no replacement trees or omitted outcomes. Failures remain reported. Reproduction uses new paths.
planning_knowledge: Earlier stationary-model results, analytic derivations, literature and dataset schema/quality audits were known. No new 20-case Q, context-bin, calibration-moment or stochastic outcome was generated before this local freeze. This is not external preregistration.
